segments.Táto stránka používa cookies. Nevyhnutné: This website uses cookies. Necessary cookies are always active. Analytics cookies are only activated with your consent. You can change your settings at any time in the footer of the page.
segments.Cookies sú malé textové súbory, ktoré sa: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device (computer, tablet, phone) when you visit a website. They help the website work properly and give us information about how you use our website.
segments.Zabezpečujú základnú funkčnosť stránky —: They ensure the basic functionality of the website — e.g. remembering your cookie preferences.
segments.Pomáhajú nám pochopiť, ako návštevníci p: They help us understand how visitors use the website — which pages they visit and where they come from.
segments.Na meranie návštevnosti používame službu: To measure traffic, we use the Google Analytics service provided by Google LLC. This service collects anonymised data about visits (pages, time, device, country). IP addresses are anonymised and are not shared with third parties for advertising purposes.
segments.Nastavenia cookies môžete kedykoľvek zme: You can change your cookie settings at any time:
segments.<strong>Na tejto stránke</strong> — klik: On this website — click the “Cookies” link in the footer of the page
segments.<strong>V prehliadači</strong> — nastave: In your browser — you will find the cookie settings in your browser options (Settings → Privacy)
segments.<strong>Google Analytics</strong> — môže: Google Analytics — you can opt out via Google Analytics Opt-out
segments.Upozorňujeme, že vypnutie nevyhnutných c: Please note that disabling necessary cookies may affect how the website works.
segments.Tieto zásady môžeme príležitostne aktual: We may update this policy from time to time. We will inform you of significant changes by a notice on the website. The date of the last update is shown in the header of this document.
segments.Ak máte otázky týkajúce sa používania co: If you have any questions about the use of cookies on this website, please contact us:
